description: This file defines the ConfigImporter class responsible for importing configuration changes within Drupal, handling extension (module/theme) processing, validation, and synchronization tasks.

classes.name: ConfigImporter
classes.description: Handles importing configuration changes, extension management, validation, and synchronization in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ConfigImporter with dependencies such as storage comparer, event dispatcher, config manager, lock backend, extension lists, and handlers.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Logs an error message encountered during import.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns the list of error messages logged during import.

methods.name: getStorageComparer
methods.description: Retrieves the storage comparer used to determine configuration changes.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the storage comparer and internal processed lists, preparing for a new import.

methods.name: getEmptyExtensionsProcessedList
methods.description: Provides an empty structure for extension processing lists.

methods.name: hasUnprocessedConfigurationChanges
methods.description: Checks if there are any configuration changes that haven't been processed yet.

methods.name: getProcessedConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the list of processed configuration changes for a given collection.

methods.name: setProcessedConfiguration
methods.description: Marks a specific configuration change as processed.

methods.name: getUnprocessedConfiguration
methods.description: Gets a list of configuration changes that are unprocessed for a specific operation and collection.

methods.name: getProcessedExtensions
methods.description: Returns the list of processed extension (module/theme) changes.

methods.name: setProcessedExtension
methods.description: Marks an extension change as processed.

methods.name: createExtensionChangelist
methods.description: Builds the list of extension changes (install/uninstall) based on current and target states.

methods.name: getExtensionChangelist
methods.description: Retrieves the list of extension changes for a given type and operation.

methods.name: getUnprocessedExtensions
methods.description: Gets unprocessed extension changes for a specific extension type.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Performs the import process, including validation, extension processing, configuration synchronization, and missing content handling.

methods.name: doSyncStep
methods.description: Executes a specific synchronization step, either a method or callable.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Prepares the importer for batch processing, including acquiring locks and setting up extension and configuration processing steps.

methods.name: processExtensions
methods.description: Processes extension (module/theme) install/uninstall operations in batch.

methods.name: processConfigurations
methods.description: Processes configuration changes (delete/create/rename/update) in batch.

methods.name: processMissingContent
methods.description: Handles missing content dependencies during import.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Finalizes the import, releases locks, and resets internal state.

methods.name: getNextExtensionOperation
methods.description: Determines the next extension operation (install/uninstall) to process.

methods.name: getNextConfigurationOperation
methods.description: Determines the next configuration change (delete/create/rename/update) to process.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the configuration changes, including rename checks and dispatching validation events.

methods.name: processConfiguration
methods.description: Processes an individual configuration change, handling errors and invoking import methods.

methods.name: processExtension
methods.description: Processes an extension (module/theme) change, including invoking install/uninstall and re-injecting services.

methods.name: checkOp
methods.description: Validates that a configuration operation (delete/create/rename/update) is still valid before processing.

methods.name: importConfig
methods.description: Imports a specific configuration change from source to target storage.

methods.name: importInvokeOwner
methods.description: Invokes import methods on configuration entity storage, supporting entity-based configs.

methods.name: importInvokeRename
methods.description: Handles importing a configuration rename operation.

methods.name: alreadyImporting
methods.description: Checks if a configuration import is already in progress.

methods.name: reInjectMe
methods.description: Rebuilds the service container to keep dependencies in sync during module installation/uninstallation.
